event: Identify the location of a ticking sound relative to a robot standing by the gray reclining lounge chair with ottoman and facing the sink with a tap.

sounding_object.description: The gas stovetop. It is a stainless steel unit with multiple black burners and grates, integrated into a white countertop. It has several black control knobs on its front face. The ticking sound is from its igniter.

reference_object.object_name: Gray reclining lounge chair with ottoman
reference_object.description: A large, dark gray or black upholstered reclining lounge chair with a matching ottoman. It is located in the living room area.

facing_object.description: A white, likely ceramic, farmhouse-style kitchen sink integrated into a white kitchen island countertop. It has a tall, gooseneck-style chrome tap. It is located in the kitchen.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the gray reclining lounge chair with ottoman and facing the sink with a tap, when the ticking sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
